{"consolidated_memory":"**Data loss issues in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side)**

Same corner of mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt as earlier data loss work. Two distinct incidents, both discovered via signal of local row missing after next launch. Both reproduced by: force stop the app with unsynced edits.

**Incident 1 [2026-03-24]:**
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #5108, branch fix/data-loss-1
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 23 days running

**Incident 2 [2026-08-12]:**
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #9420, branch fix/data-loss-2
- Result: backlog cleared 31 minutes after the deploy"}
